title: Xdrip dropping Miaomiao connection
symptom: After a reasonably long period running relatively smoothly, I am now losing Bluetooth connection to my Miaomiao every hour or two. Restarting Bluetooth and clearing the cache works temporarily. The Xdrip connection to my Miband also fails at the same time and reverts to the standard watchface until connection is remade.
cause: The Miaomiao connection problems were traced to the UK Gov NHS Covid tracking app causing Bluetooth conflicts.
fix: The user resolved the Miaomiao connection issue by identifying the UK Gov NHS Covid tracking app as the cause of Bluetooth conflicts. The Miband connection issue was solved in the latest release.
evidence_quote: Miaomiao connection problems traced to UK Gov NHS Covid tracking app causing Bluetooth conflicts.
